book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Maluku

content: Yecho inamicha mundo jwatengwike lubhoko
Kabhele Yecho ajhakujhingii munyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude. Mwenio akibha mundo jwatengwike lubhoko.
Bhando bhange bhapaliya kihokola cha kunkamuu Yecho. Bhajhakuningulila anda chanamicha mundo Lichiko lya Kupomolela.
Yecho akannobholile mundo jwatengwike lubhoko jhola, “Nhwike palonge pano.”
Chakaka, akakonyite bhando, “Bho, nike chambone kuhenga Lichiko lya Kupomolela, kuntangatila amu kuntendela uhakaho? Kughombola ughome gwa mundo amu kunkoma?” Nambo bheniya bhakajhangwiijhe kilebhe.

Yecho akalolikii bhando kwa lilaka, peniya ajhakunyongeka kumwojho kwa kukokotoka kwa miojho jhabhe. Bhahe, Yecho akanobholile mundo jhola, “Atambula lubhoko!” Na jwenio ajhakuatambuu lubhoko lwake ajhakulama.
Peniya Mapwalichayo bhakapitite panja, bhajhakukongana na bhando bha Helode na bhajhakupalaha ndela jha kunkoma Yecho.
Lilongo lya bhando linkengama Yecho
Yecho pamonga na bhabholwa bhake, bhakajhahwii mupele mulilabha lya ku Galilaya na lilongo lya bhando likankengime, bhahumila ku Galilaya na ku Yudeya.
Bhando pubhajhohina ghoha ghateii, bhando mahena bhakahika kubhoka ku Yudeya na ku Yeluchalemo na ku Idumeya na chenda jhibhii kwiye jha lukemba lwa ku Yolodane na miche jha ku Tilo na ku Sidone.
Nhwalo gwa bhando kujholoka, Yecho akalobhalile bhabholwa bhake bhantengenechele ngalabha bhando bhakoto kunkangana.
Nhwalo alamiche bhando bhamahele, bhibhalwalwa bhoha bhajhakuheghelela bhapala kumpapaha.
Na bhando bhina michuka pubhamwonita, bhajhakugwegha palonge jhake na kulalama, “Mwenga ndi Mwana gwa Chapanga!”
Nambo Yecho ajhakwapwatalila kwa likakala nchuka ukoto kwalobholela bhando jwenie ndi ghane.
Yecho ihaghuu akatenga kome na bhabhele
Yecho akahobhike pakitombe, ajhakwakema jwabhapaii jwenio, na bhene bhajhakunyendela.
Jwenio akabhahagwii bhando kome na bhabhele, ajhakwakema akatenga. Ajhakwalobholela, “Nihagwii mangota mwenga kutama na nenga kwatangachii bhando Malobhe gha Mbone.
Na mangota namaha na ukindendeke gwa kubhenga michuka.”
Bhamba ndi bhando kome na bhabhele bhakabhahagwii. Simone Yecho akampekihe liina lya Petile,
Yakobu na Yohane, bhana bha Chebedayo bheniya Yecho akabhapekihe liina Boanelige, mana jhake, “Bhando bhubhabhii ngita Ulumbilo na kwa malobhe ghange bhikemwa bhina kipyaho.”
Anduleya na Filipu na Batulomayo na Matei na Tomache na Yakobu mwana gwa Alufayo na Tadayo na Simone jwakemita Chelote, mana jhake nkomanii kilambo chake.
Na Yuda Ichikaliyote, jwanyambila Yecho.
Yecho na Belezebule
Peniya Yecho akajhahwii kajha, bhando bhamahele bhakakonganike kabhele ade Yecho na bhabholwa bhake bhakahotwii ndeka kulyegha.
Akalongo bhake Yecho bhakajhohine malobhe, bhakajhahwii kuntola nhwalo bhalongela jhuna ngholoka.
Na Bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo gha Mucha bhubhahumila ku Yeluchalemo bhakalongii, “Akwete Belezebule! Nkolo jwa michuka jwenio jwapiya likakala lya kubhenga michuka.”
Yecho akakemite, ajhakwalobholela kwa kulandanikiya, “Limbembela lihoto bho kummenga Limbembela?
Unahota nkolongwa ghoghoha ghola anda upechengine gwenie kwa gwenie na kubhehe ibhogha ibhogha gwihoto ndeka kujhema, na bhando bha nyumba jhimo.
Anda bhando bha nyumba bhapechangine ibhoghaibhogha, nyumba jhene nahigwa tugha.
Anda Unahota gwa Limbembela upechengine ibhoghaibhogha, unahota gwonio naubhejhe na likakala.”
“Abhii jhe mundo jwapala kujhingii munyumba jha mundo jhuna likakala na kutolajhe ilebhe yake, ade antabhe mundo jwenio. Peniya nahotola kumpoka ilebhe yake.”
“Ninnobholela chakaka, bhando nabhalekekewa uhakaho gwabhe na kulapanikiya kwabhe.
Nambo mundo jhojhoha jwauligha Uhuke gwa Chapanga nahotola ndeka kulekekewa uhakaho gwake, nahighalika na uhakaho gwake machiko ghoha ghangapeta.”
Yecho akalongii naha nhwalo gwa bhando bhakannobhalille, “Abhii na michuka.”
Majhe na akalongo bhake Yecho
Peniya majhe mundo Yecho na akalongo bhake bakahikite. Akalongo bhakajhemite panja, bhakantumite mundo kunkema Yecho.
Bhando bhamahele bakantindii Yecho, na mundo jhumo mmola akanobhalile, “Majhe gwino na akalongo bhino bhabhii panja, bhipalaha mwenga.”
Yecho ajhakwakonya, “Bho, majhe gwango na akalongo bhango akina ghane?”
Peniya akalolakiye bhando bhubhantindii ajhakulonge, “Dolokeya! Nalobholela bhamba anda majhe gwango na akalongo bhango!
Mundo jhojhoha jwahenga ghapala Chapanga, jwenio ndi nnombo gwango na nhwacha gwango na majhe gwango.”
